# gate_qwen3vl_tower read as pinned below, but the rows that carry `@615.71.09=<bytes>`).
# The plain jit_local column is the pin of every listed driver its row has no exception for. A row measured on one driver is its
# plain value, provisional for the other until that driver's scan confirms it or adds its exception. A driver the line below does not
# list is not held on jit_local (tools/ptx-spill-check.sh header, «The driver»).
# PIN(2026-11-17): the jit_local column was held on every driver; drivers 595.99.02 and 615.71.09 read five rows differently (the scan
